test_quantize_with_scheme: test AutoRound quantization with MXFP4, NVFP4, W2A16G64, or GGUF schemes using enable_alg_ext
test_2bit_quantization: test 2-bit quantization with AutoRound using bits=2, group_size=64, and enable_alg_ext=True
test_cli_quantization: test the auto_round CLI module with enable_alg_ext, avg_bits, and options flags
run_quantize_and_save: run AutoRound quantize_and_save to produce a quantized model and evaluate accuracy with evaluate_accuracy
review_autoscheme_config: review AutoScheme configuration with options, avg_bits, and ignore_scale_zp_bits parameters
